title: Bijection by deleting a specified element
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $i$ be an index with $0\le i<n$. Deleting $i$ defines a bijection from the subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ that contain $i$ to those that do not contain $i$; its inverse adjoins $i$.
